media.title: Sievering Film Studio, Vienna — Wien-Film view, c. 1945
media.description: View of the Wien-Film studio complex at Sieveringer Straße 135, formerly operated by Sascha-Filmindustrie, around 1945. The photograph provides later physical context for the studio site; it does not depict the complex during Kaper’s European career.
media.altText: Black-and-white view of the Sievering studio complex in Vienna, showing an arched-roof production hall marked Wien-Film, trees and adjoining buildings.
media.publicCaption: The Wien-Film studio complex at Sieveringer Straße 135, Vienna, around 1945; formerly the Sievering studios of Sascha-Filmindustrie.

places.authorizedName: Sieveringer Filmatelier / Sievering Studios, Sieveringer Straße 135, 1190 Vienna-Döbling
places.publicNote: Historical film-studio site at Sieveringer Straße 135 in Vienna’s 19th district, Döbling. The studio complex operated at this address from the Sascha-Film era and no longer survives in its historical form.
